data.title: About forms.
items: Do people need an app to fill in a form?
No. Forms open in the phone’s browser. People confirm with their phone number, so answers land on the right record.
Can I use a form without a Catch event?
Yes. A survey or an application for a programme works on its own. You can add the people to an event later.
Can questions depend on earlier answers?
Yes. Show a question only when an earlier answer calls for it.
Yes, with a waiver form: the terms, the acknowledgement and a signature, kept as a receipt for that event.
Can I bring in my Google Forms responses?
Yes. Export them as a file and import them as applications, matching your columns to the form’s questions.
Does filling in a form sign people up for marketing?
No. Hearing from you later is a separate yes, which you can ask for on the form.
